extracted.intended_audience: general public and prospective MacArthur Fellows (creative professionals, researchers, and others interested in the Fellows Program)
extracted.subtask_description: Page-level overview of the MacArthur Fellows Program: its mission, public-facing materials (press releases, media coverage, fellows listings), and staff. Not an application form — describes the fellowship as no-strings-attached and highlights program impact and communication channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program mission — celebrate and inspire creative potential
rubrics_metrics.description: The MacArthur Fellows Program celebrates and inspires the creative potential of individuals through no-strings-attached fellowships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page frames the fellowship as an unrestricted award intended to recognize and catalyze individual creativity and potential. Evidence on the page includes fellows listings, press releases (e.g., 'Meet the 2014 MacArthur Fellows'), media items, and an overview video. No application criteria or selection rubric are provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional commitment — building a more just, verdant, and peaceful world
rubrics_metrics.description: Committed to building a more just, verdant, and peaceful world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Fellows Program is presented within the MacArthur Foundation's broader institutional goals and values; related content emphasizes program impact and inspiration (e.g., a review affirming impact, data about fellows' mobility, and media coverage). This is a mission/value statement rather than an operational selection standard on the page.
